description: This file declares functions related to managing a hierarchy of command names within a process environment, including appending command names to the hierarchy, retrieving the hierarchy, and releasing resources.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_append_hierarchy
methods.description: Appends the specified command name to the current process's command name hierarchy.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_get_hierarchy
methods.description: Returns the command name hierarchy for the current process.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the command name hierarchy.
